definitions.explanation: An early round in a competition to determine who advances to the main event.

examples.japanese: {予選|よせん}を{通過|つうか}した。
{予選|よせん}で{敗退|はいたい}した。
examples.english: We were eliminated in the preliminaries.

examples.japanese: ワールドカップの{予選|よせん}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: The World Cup qualifiers have started.

examples.japanese: {地区|ちく}{予選|よせん}で{優勝|ゆうしょう}して、{全国|ぜんこく}{大会|たいかい}に{出場|しゅつじょう}することになった。
examples.english: We won the regional qualifiers and will compete in the national tournament.

examples.japanese: {予選|よせん}は{来月|らいげつ}から{始|はじ}まるので、それまでに{練習|れんしゅう}を{重|かさ}ねて{万全|ばんぜん}の{準備|じゅんび}をしたい。
examples.english: The qualifiers start next month, so I want to practice hard and be fully prepared by then.

notes:
{予選|よせん} refers to preliminary or qualifying rounds in competitions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {予選|よせん}を{通過|つうか}する: to pass the preliminaries
- {予選|よせん}で{敗退|はいたい}する: to be eliminated in preliminaries
- {予選|よせん}{落|お}ち: eliminated in preliminaries (casual)
- {予選|よせん}リーグ: group stage
- {予選|よせん}{大会|たいかい}: qualifying tournament

COMPOUNDS:
- {地区|ちく}{予選|よせん}: regional qualifiers
- {一次|いちじ}{予選|よせん}: first round of qualifiers
- {最終|さいしゅう}{予選|よせん}: final qualifiers

USAGE:
Used in sports, music auditions, competitions, and any event with elimination rounds.

ANTONYM:
{決勝|けっしょう} (final round) - {予選|よせん} leads to {本選|ほんせん} (main competition) and eventually {決勝|けっしょう}.
